mapper.select: SELECT comment_id, user_id, comment_content, movie_id, comment_time FROM comment ORDER BY comment_time DESC
SELECT c.comment_id, c.user_id, c.comment_content, c.movie_id, c.comment_time FROM comment c INNER JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.user_name = #{userName} ORDER BY c.comment_time DESC
SELECT comment_id, user_id, comment_content, movie_id, comment_time FROM comment WHERE comment_content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY comment_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment(user_id, comment_content, movie_id, comment_time) VALUES(#{userId}, #{commentContent}, #{movieId}, #{commentTime})
mapper.update:
UPDATE comment
comment_content = #{commentContent},
comment_time = #{commentTime},
WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
